title: What If a Worm Frozen 46,000 Years Woke Up and Had Babies?

scenes.text: What if an animal frozen for 46,000 years came back to life? One did.
Scientists found tiny roundworms in Siberian permafrost near the Kolyma River, in an ancient animal burrow.
Dating of plant material beside them suggested roughly 46,000 years.
After thawing, the worms moved, ate bacteria, and reproduced.
Their offspring have been raised for more than 100 generations in the lab. The originals have died.
Their trick is cryptobiosis, a shutdown so deep their metabolism falls too low to detect, until water and warmth return.

description:
